body_markdown:
Before the blockbuster albums, sold-out shows, and Latin Grammys nominations,


[ELENA ROSE](https://open.spotify.com/intl-es/artist/0zO8yNnw5GQgutcIyXfGBY) ,


[Trueno](https://open.spotify.com/intl-es/artist/2x7PC78TmgqpEIjaGAZ0Oz) ,


[Silvana Estrada](https://open.spotify.com/intl-es/artist/72VywtXEoONiBLNu3ibGI7) ,


[Samuraï](https://open.spotify.com/intl-es/artist/0BovidHLtM9n55WXWkApK9) , and


[Joaquina](https://open.spotify.com/intl-es/artist/081F5qgtVMfcHZKDY1IEa0) were musicians trying to find their voices. They were also members of Spotify’s global


[RADAR program](https://newsroom.spotify.com/radar/) , which spotlights emerging artists at pivotal moments in their careers and helps introduce their music to new audiences.


Their journeys come full circle at Casa Spotify Las Vegas on November 11. Ahead of the Latin Grammys on November 12, these RADAR alumni will come together to celebrate the many sounds, scenes, and stories shaping Latin music today.


This year marks Spotify’s fourth iteration of the event in Las Vegas and ninth year in attendance at Latin Grammys Week. Ahead of the big night, we dug into the data behind these artists’ stories.


## **ELENA ROSE: Building a solo career with a global audience**


When Venezuelan singer-songwriter ELENA ROSE joined RADAR in September 2020, she was stepping into the spotlight as a solo artist after writing songs for artists including


[Bad Bunny](https://open.spotify.com/artist/4q3ewBCX7sLwd24euuV69X?si=g_Jp-SVGT02tgkzSAUzPCw) ,


[KAROL G](https://open.spotify.com/artist/790FomKkXshlbRYZFtlgla?si=p8uf3lX-SIKCjOoFv1GPCQ) ,


[Rauw Alejandro](https://open.spotify.com/artist/1mcTU81TzQhprhouKaTkpq?si=JVFDucsmSeK3pBx-Jhv4Jw) , and


[Selena Gomez](https://open.spotify.com/artist/0C8ZW7ezQVs4URX5aX7Kqx?si=NlF1LKoZQ0my20IlIauJpQ) . Since then, she has become one of Latin pop’s most defining voices. Her music has reached listeners around the world, with 87% of her Spotify streams coming from outside Venezuela. This year, she also became the first Latina songwriter to receive the BMI Impact Award and earned a Latin Grammy nomination for Record of the Year for “


[ALMA](https://open.spotify.com/track/3DNPOTO44kCKUV9RkYU77G?si=113a0a4b8f5045bc) .”


## **Trueno: From Buenos Aires freestyle to the global charts**


Trueno joined RADAR South Cone in 2020, four months before his debut album,


[Atrevido](https://open.spotify.com/album/1xBoZOfcOsqd77V6AENKYC?si=BEUpRBZsRzuc5DjKlvP7Dw) *.* Already one of Buenos Aires’s most exciting freestyle rappers, the La Boca native has taken his music far beyond home, with 81% of his streams now coming from outside Argentina. “


[Mamichula](https://open.spotify.com/track/0TUW9faHNaBmi89wsYGp9y?si=971605d43ca343bb) ” put Trueno on the global charts for the first time, and each of his albums has since surpassed 1 billion streams. This year, he earned a Latin Grammy nomination for “


[Gil](https://open.spotify.com/track/5jgmQkVypORb3enASCxjYs?si=c78043b9bdfa4160) ,” his collaboration with


[Milo j](https://open.spotify.com/artist/19HM5j0ULGSmEoRcrSe5x3?si=TzFo3qqMSkOKCx6dpIpA7A) .


## **Silvana Estrada: Spotify Mexico’s first RADAR artist**


Silvana Estrada became one of Spotify’s first


[RADAR México](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DXbpJNWtkXDpL) artists in 2020. In the years since, the songwriter has emerged as one of the country’s most distinctive contemporary voices, known for her deeply personal songs and captivating performances. After winning Best New Artist at the 2022 Latin Grammys, Silvana reached another milestone in 2026: selling out two nights at Mexico City’s Auditorio Nacional. Her self-produced album,


[Vendrán Suaves Lluvias](https://open.spotify.com/album/7MJAlq9PJGZJcQRQ53wJna?si=HYs-SLVjR9icJTjCszulPQ) , earned six Latin Grammy nominations this year, including Album, Record, and Song of the Year.


## **Samuraï: A new voice in Spanish alternative pop**


**Samuraï** joined


[RADAR España](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX2KWq7Xwva8j) in 2024, with a sound that blends pop rock, alternative rock, and urban influences with candid, emotionally charged storytelling. Her debut album,


[El Silencio Del Ruido](https://open.spotify.com/album/3CB6CuXulfgqnVNSpfSEfT?si=6HT0pEKFRBK6wMOsCmUpJQ) , toured across Spain and sold out venues across the country, while “


[El Principio de algo](https://open.spotify.com/track/10KB4HkYIpNOd0QhyohMre?si=1b27883ac1f54857) ,” her collaboration with Spanish group


[La La Love You](https://open.spotify.com/artist/5Q30fhTc0Sl0Q4C5dOjhhQ?si=8iuUEoVFSo6irJXw4koKfA) has reached over 111 million streams.


## **Joaquina: Songs that travel beyond borders**


Caracas-born and Miami-raised singer-songwriter Joaquina joined RADAR in 2024, one year after winning Best New Artist at the Latin Grammys. In 2025, she released her debut studio album,


[al romper la burbuja](https://open.spotify.com/album/1LSYcBB35ODdWSVRm7imVM?si=9KN39i5fSHS6VBhX8McLUg) , which earned four Latin Grammy nominations, including Album of the Year. Her 2026 deluxe edition added five new songs, with “


[amarillo](https://open.spotify.com/track/6ULnlEp0Oto5F7fMQaokwD?si=f7d9a13ee1f348a9) ” and “


[generación digital](https://open.spotify.com/track/3oqWG9ibCDsDpANzslo3rP?si=088681520c3843a4) ” now nominated for Best Pop Song and Best Singer-Songwriter Song, respectively.
